name: nanoskills
description: nano skills bundle: nanocrt (nano Content Research Tool - idea-first, turns a video idea into a two-column A/V script), nanostory (nano Story Tool - footage-first, turns a folder of existing travel footage into a narrated script plus an editor-ready timeline plan), and nanoprd (nano PRD - turns a product idea into nanotasks a coding agent can implement one at a time). All run five approval-gated phases.
